propositions: Every typed configuration field emitted through _SECTION_CLASSES must have a nonempty public_description metadata field that explains user-visible effects or operational consequences.
The configuration reference generator must fail when encountering a field without description metadata, naming the offending key in the error message.
Generated descriptions must be distinct from and not merely restate the field's type, default value, or lifecycle.
Field annotations, defaults, default factories, coercion behavior, and runtime configuration behavior must remain unchanged after adding public_description metadata.
The configuration schema modules must remain within the 800-line absolute size limit after extracting VerifyConfig validation helpers.
Generated Markdown table output must correctly escape table-sensitive content in Description cells.
